mapper.select: SELECT u.created_at FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = FALSE
SELECT sr.record_date AS record_date, COALESCE(SUM(sr.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(sr.id) AS transaction_count FROM service_record sr WHERE GROUP BY sr.record_date ORDER BY sr.record_date

SELECT COALESCE(sr.changed_category, sr.category) AS category, COALESCE(SUM(sr.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(sr.id) AS transaction_count FROM service_record sr WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(sr.changed_category, sr.category) ORDER BY amount DESC, category

SELECT COALESCE(sr.changed_category, sr.category) AS category, COALESCE(SUM(sr.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(sr.id) AS transaction_count FROM service_record sr WHERE AND DAYOFWEEK(sr.record_date) IN (1, 7) GROUP BY COALESCE(sr.changed_category, sr.category) ORDER BY amount DESC, category LIMIT 1
